skills.description:
Prompt 补全大师 v2.0——基于 Context 感知与 40 槽口 Schema 的提示词补全与优化引擎。
当用户提供的 prompt 不完整、模糊、缺少关键约束时，自动识别缺口并补全为
可执行、可复现、结构严谨、直达本质的完整 prompt。支持单轮补全、多轮追问、
反向瘦身、场景模板套用四种模式。40 槽口覆盖角色/目标/输入/输出/约束/边界/
流程/质量/认知/伦理/商业/安全/工程/体验/演进/元层 16 个维度，全方位无死角。
触发词：补全 prompt、完善提示词、prompt 补全、prompt 优化、把这段 prompt 补全、
这段 prompt 缺什么、帮我补 prompt、prompt completion、提示词补全大师、
40 槽口、schema 补全、直达本质。
skills.description_zh:
What it is — A context-aware engine that turns half-baked prompts into complete, reusable, high-quality ones. Based on the 40-Slot Schema.

Core philosophy — "Cut to the bone." No fluff, no filler. Every question drilled to the atomic level. Output must be copy-paste ready.

Four modes — One-Shot Completion / Multi-Round Probing / Reverse Slimdown / Template Generation.

40 slots × 16 dimensions — covering everything from Role through Meta.

Three scripts — slot-analyzer, banned-words checker, template-generator. All pure Python stdlib, zero deps.

Activation — trigger keywords in WorkBuddy or @prompt-completion-master.
skills.name: prompt-completion-master.
